input.sparql:
PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#> 
PREFIX ref: <https://buildgraph.org/ref#>
SELECT ?point ?class ?ts
WHERE {
  ?zone rdfs:label "Perimeter_mid_ZN_1" .
  ?zone brick:hasPoint ?point .
  ?point rdf:type ?class .
  ?point ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts .
}

SELECT ?point ?p ?o
WHERE {
  ?zone rdfs:label "Perimeter_mid_ZN_1" .
  ?zone brick:hasPoint ?point .
  ?point ?p ?o .
  FILTER(?p != rdf:type)
}
